grammar.title: 旁边 and 中间 for relative position
grammar.explanation: 旁边 (pángbiān, "next to/beside") and 中间 (zhōngjiān, "in the middle") describe where something is relative to something else. Combine them with 在: 他在我旁边 ("He's next to me").

grammar.title: 方位词 + 边 for location words
grammar.pattern: direction + 边 (东边/西边/南边/北边/上边/下边/前边/后边/左边/右边/里边/外边)
grammar.explanation: Adding 边 (biān) to a direction or position word makes a full location noun: 左边 ("the left side"), 里边 ("the inside"), 前边 ("the front"). These combine naturally with 在: 商店在右边 ("The store is on the right").

grammar.title: 这儿/哪儿 as spoken alternatives
grammar.explanation: 这儿 (zhèr) and 哪儿 (nǎr) are casual, conversational equivalents of 这里 ("here") and 哪里 ("where"). They're used exactly the same way, most often right after 在.

grammar.title: 儿 as a colloquial suffix (erhua)
grammar.explanation: Adding 儿 (r) to certain words gives them a casual, spoken flavor typical of northern Mandarin: 那 → 那儿 ("there"), 玩 → 玩儿 ("to play"), 女孩 → 女孩儿 ("girl"). It's written as its own character but pronounced fused onto the syllable before it, and doesn't change the core meaning.
